lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is wider on the anterior flank and becomes progressively narrower towards the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the eighth vertical line (counting from anterior to posterior), splitting in the upper third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines and the final posterior line are abbreviated segments that terminate before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned above the calcaneal tendon area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-posterior haunch align spatially to form a semi-diagonal geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Straight V-shaped projection with a slight inward convergence at the tips, angled approximately 45 degrees from the frontal bone of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the pixel width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white chevron marking between the eyes and two distinct white spots on the lateral mandible/cheek area.
